HOScrcpy-python integration source notice

Upstream: https://github.com/lizongxun1995/HOScrcpy-python
Snapshot commit: af9e50ff2c671c135f48a0c80717fcd35880d639
Retrieved: 2026-10-15
License: MIT, as declared in upstream LICENSE and pyproject.toml.
Upstream LICENSE is preserved here verbatim.

The hos_scrcpy Python/proto sources are vendored from this snapshot.
Native .so resources are not committed to this source repository.
The fetch_harmony_assets.py script downloads a pinned upstream JAR and
verifies resources against assets.json before installing them locally.
The original resources were extracted from
HOScrcpy-main/HOScrcpy-main/web_demo/libs/hosScrcpy-1.0.15-beta.jar in the
upstream repository archive. The application does not execute the JAR or
require a Java installation. These are device-side resources, not host libraries.

Application adapters are gui/utils/mirror_backend.py and
gui/widgets/device_mirror.py; upstream Python sources were not modified.
The GUI uses PyAV for H.264 decoding, a latest-frame mailbox, independent
input/video worker ownership and manual/AI input exclusion. Snapshot fallback
uses HDC commands independently of gRPC/PyAV, with unique temporary files.
Native support depends on the device's HarmonyOS/uitest and ABI versions.
